title: GommeHD.net
description: GommeHD.net is one of Europe’s largest Minecraft server networks, offering a wide range of minigames and other content like CityBuild. No mods required!
body:
Hey ho Minecrafter! 👋

We are one of Europe's largest Minecraft server networks. Jump into classics like BedWars and SkyWars, or try fan-favorites like Duels and CityBuild. There is a gamemode for everyone.

Want to see more? Watch our server trailer and discover what the server has to offer:
